title: The Pre-Nup
cn: 第 2 集 · 婚前协议
novel: Barney designed an [[extensive|extensive]] pre-nup before his wedding to Quinn. The document was very [[detailed|detailed]] and contained many unusual [[clauses|clause]]. Quinn was [[shocked|shock]] when she read the document. She could not believe Barney wanted to control so many aspects of their marriage. The pre-nup included rules about weight gain, [[appearance|appearance]], and even how often they could see their friends. Quinn felt [[insulted|insult]] and told Barney the agreement was [[ridiculous|ridiculous]]. She said she would not sign anything that treated her like a [[possession|possession]]. The other guys in the group started proposing their own relationship [[amendments|amendment]]. Ted suggested rules about [[punctuality|punctuality]] and cleanliness. Marshall wanted rules about shared [[chores|chore]]. Even Robin's boyfriend came up with his own list of demands. The women were angry about all these rules and [[demands|demand]]. Lily said the whole thing was [[childish|childish]]. She told Marshall that marriage was about [[compromise|compromise]], not control. Robin agreed and said a real relationship was built on [[trust|trust]], not contracts. Quinn confronted Barney and told him to tear up the pre-nup. She said she would not marry him if he could not [[trust|trust]] her. Barney [[realized|realize]] he was being unreasonable and [[agreed|agree]] to rip up the document. He said he just wanted to protect himself because he was scared.

clause.en: a section of a legal document

chore.en: a small job around the house

compromise.en: an agreement reached by both sides
